review:
Always Up! is a 3x3, five-line slot inspired by Chinese mythology with a crash-style bonus. Three scatters on reels 1, 2 and 3 trigger it.

In the bonus, rockets launch into the sky, each carrying a multiplier that grows as it climbs, and each explodes at a random height. The multiplier on your rocket is applied to your bet, up to a maximum of 599x in this mode. The bonus can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 559x maximum multiplier and a 96.07% RTP. It's light and casual, while Always Up! x10000 is the high-variance alternative.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
